text: Salam Kissan Sarsabz Pakistan 🇵🇰🌾 Dil se shukriya Pakistan ke mehnati kisanón ko aap hi hamari zameen ki rooh aur mulk ki taqat ho. Aap ki mehnat se hamare gharon tak rozi pohanchti hai aur Pakistan sarsabz rehta hai. Saath hi Sarsabz Fertilizer management ka bhi tahe-dil se shukriya, jo Kissan ko empower karne ke liye Kissan Day (18 Dec) jaise meaningful events ke zariye rehnumai, himmat aur support faraham kar rahe hain. Aap ki koshishen kisani ko mazid behtar aur mustahkam bana rahi hain. Allah aap sab ki mehnat ko qabool kare aur Pakistan ko hamesha sarsabz o shaadab rakhe. 🌱🤲 #SalamKissan #SarsabzPakistan
